K_seed_contract_audit.classification_principle: SPEC precedence over official execution defaults. This is NOT a silently chosen hyperparameter: the benchmark seed is mandated by the frozen specification and the adapter must propagate it. No adapter is implemented in M6A1.

E03.official_behaviour: No seed surface at all. Unseeded Python random.randint and np.random.rand inside tf.py_func (model/dataset.py:106,116,127,135); unseeded tf.random.uniform (train.py:63-69); no tf.set_random_seed anywhere. Additionally model/dataset.py:65,67 use dataset.shuffle(...).map(num_parallel_calls=AUTOTUNE), so parallel py_func calls consume the shared Python/NumPy global RNG in a nondeterministic order: a global seed alone is NOT sufficient.
E03.required_future_adapter: Propagate the benchmark seed into Python random, NumPy and the TensorFlow graph-level seed, AND make RNG consumption order deterministic (derive the per-element seed from the sample id, or serialise the map stage). Seeding alone does not make this method reproducible.
E03.residual_note: The adapter requirement is a design obligation, not an unresolved scientific value: the model math is unchanged and the spec's 3-seed mean+-std reporting is what absorbs stream choice. E03's separate blocker E03-2r (iBUG-68 flip permutation) is unaffected; disabling the flip augmentation would settle E03-2r and remove one of the two RNG consumers at the same time.
E03.spec_requirement: each required M6 run uses its benchmark seed from [42, 1337, 2026]

E06c.official_behaviour: No seeding of any kind in train_generator.py, generated.py or data/generation_dataset.py: no torch.manual_seed, no random.seed, no np.random.seed. cudnn.benchmark = True (train_generator.py:57 and generated.py:36) selects algorithms nondeterministically. DataLoader(shuffle=True, num_workers=8) has no worker_init_fn and no generator. Latent draws use torch.zeros(...).normal_(0,1) (train_generator.py:199-200, generated.py:47-48). Source pinning alone does NOT make this reproducible.
E06c.required_future_adapter: Propagate the benchmark seed into Python random, NumPy, torch CPU and CUDA RNGs; set cudnn.benchmark = False and cudnn.deterministic = True; add a DataLoader worker_init_fn and an explicit generator. The repository already has this exact pattern in gpatbench/probe/train.py (seed_everything, apply_determinism, worker_init_fn).
E06c.residual_note: Does not affect E06c-2 (LightCNN weight not fetched), which remains blocking.
E06c.spec_requirement: each required M6 run uses its benchmark seed from [42, 1337, 2026]

E07c.official_behaviour: FAS_train.py:180 calls seed_torch(seed=1) unconditionally; the --random_seed argument (default 2024) is never read. seed_torch does seed Python random, PYTHONHASHSEED, NumPy, torch and CUDA, and sets cudnn.benchmark=False, cudnn.deterministic=True (FAS_train.py:167-175), so the RNG surface is complete -- it is simply hard-coded to 1. DataLoader(shuffle=True) uses default workers (0).
E07c.required_future_adapter: Parameterise seed_torch so the benchmark seed is propagated instead of the constant 1.
E07c.residual_note: Does not affect E07c-3 (sampler) or E07c-4 (encoder weight), which remain blocking.
E07c.spec_requirement: each required M6 run uses its benchmark seed from [42, 1337, 2026]
E07c.superseded_statement: The v1 audit said 'Any M6 config must record 1, not 2024.' That is WITHDRAWN: the frozen spec mandates [42, 1337, 2026] and marks training seeds unchangeable, so neither 1 nor 2024 may be recorded as the M6 seed. 1 is recorded only as the official code's hard-coded behaviour.

spec_requirement.note: Frozen spec: 'All self-run results are reported over seeds [42, 1337, 2026] as mean +- standard deviation' (line 16); Appendix B lists 'Training seeds | No | 42/1337/2026', i.e. NOT changeable. Appendix B also says third-party native hyperparameters follow the official source of truth, but seeds are separately mandated, so SPEC takes precedence over any official hard-coded or missing seed.

spec_constraints.global_pseudocode: train_method(method, track, split.TRAIN, validate=split.VAL, seed=seed) — spec line 900
spec_constraints.gpat_own_rule: Section 10.6 'Generator checkpoint selection' fixes an explicit VAL SelectionScore for GPAT only (EMA epochs 10-60 on val_pairs_v1.parquet). It is NOT automatically applied to baselines.
